name: Declarative plugin YAML generation and installation
target: Generates plugin.json from a code-free plugin.yaml and graph v2 headers, verifies generated and committed content match, then installs and reloads the absorb bundle.
inputs: plugin.yaml metadata and graph asset paths
graph v2 headers with purpose, allow, policy and observe declarations
observations: graph manifests in generated JSON agree with declared graph assets
installed plugin reloads with its graph IDs and generic capability names
